sections.text: A tandem duplication at7q34 creates KIAA1549::BRAF, retaining the BRAF kinase region while removing its amino-terminal inhibitory region. Primary experiments demonstrated constitutive kinase activity and anchorage-independent fibroblast growth. It is recurrent in pilocytic astrocytoma.

report_comment.text: KIAA1549 encodes a UPF0606-family protein. BRAF encodes a RAF-family serine/threonine kinase in the MAPK pathway. A tandem duplication at7q34 creates KIAA1549::BRAF, retaining the BRAF kinase region while removing its amino-terminal inhibitory region. Primary experiments demonstrated constitutive kinase activity and anchorage-independent fibroblast growth. It is recurrent in pilocytic astrocytoma. Tovorafenib is US-approved for patients aged6months or older with relapsed or refractory pediatric low-grade glioma harboring a BRAF fusion or rearrangement.
